concerns.text: Verification for T001 only tests the missing file case; FR‑008 also requires abort when the checksum entry is missing, but no test asserts that a missing checksum triggers the RuntimeError.

T006 specifies that the top‑10 PC feature‑importance ranking must be output, yet the verification only checks the metrics CSV and JSON summary; there is no test confirming the existence or correctness of the importance ranking file.

Task T013 is a very coarse ‘comprehensive test suite’ placeholder; it bundles many distinct guardrail checks into a single task, which should be atomized into separate, concrete tasks (e.g., separate tasks for FR‑008 abort test, contract validation, CV split correctness, runtime/memory limits, etc.).
